block_instructions: Require approval for any git command that force-pushes, rewrites history, or discards work, including git push --force, git push -f, git reset --hard, git rebase, git checkout -- , git clean, and git branch -D.
Require approval for any command that deletes files or directories, such as rm, rmdir, or Remove-Item.
Require approval for any git command that changes remotes, credentials, or git config.
